name: Delivered by Friday
storyline:
Friday Kwon is a young witch who crashes into a tree while trying to surf on a broom. This accident leaves her paralyzed from the waist down and for six years she works inside the family potion shop making potions with her father. One day, her mom is injured in an accident after colliding with another rider and the shop needs Friday to return to her original post as a delivery girl.

She soon learns that her mothers injury was no accident and that the Rain Forest Witch Company deliberately attacked her and are now targeting Friday. They'll do anything they can to try to put the Kwons out of business.
summary: Friday Kwon is a young witch making her first deliveries since her spinal cord injury six years ago. In this fast-paced auto-scroller navigate the unfriendly skies as a big witch company does its best to thwart Friday.
